scope: Non-exhaustive public primary-source review; this is not a novelty or contest-eligibility certificate.

sources.name: MoonSplit
findings: Declared exact metadata keys, Unicode character q-gram text similarity, same-source interval overlaps, time-forward validation and independent audit.
The scope explicitly excludes image/audio/video similarity.

sources.name: ImageHash
sources.execution: installed and executed locally as external oracle
findings: dhash converts to grayscale, LANCZOS-resizes to 9x8 and compares each right pixel > its left neighbour for 64 bits.
Provides multiple perceptual hashing algorithms; split-specific evidence, review workflow and report packaging require integration.

sources.name: FiftyOne
sources.execution: source/docs review only, not installed or benchmarked
findings: Already supports image collections, similarity indexes and interactive near-duplicate review.

sources.name: FiftyOne Brain
findings: compute_near_duplicates uses embedding similarity; compute_leaky_splits already supports split metadata and leaks_view/leaks_for_sample/tag_leaks.

sources.name: moon-minhash
findings: MoonBit MinHash/SimHash, LSH, text tokenization, deduplication and precision/recall evaluation already exist.
Could support general candidate-search building blocks, but the reviewed entrypoint consumes document features rather than decoded-image canonical RGB evidence.
